quote.en: The enacted FY2026 NDAA authorized $890.6 billion for national defense, $8.0 billion more than requested…

post.en: The same report says the law authorized more than requested for Defense Department procurement and research, the contracts defense companies are paid for.

post.ht: Menm rapò a di lwa a te otorize plis pase sa yo te mande pou acha ak rechèch Depatman Defans, kontra yo peye konpayi defans yo pou yo.
